selection.method: lowest per-hit learned confidence in unused adult-screened encounters, with story/pattern caps and manual continuity checks
selection.sceneSeparation: Audit clusters use a 20-paragraph gap; manual review merges continued encounters and excludes continuations of previously reviewed scenes.
selection.trainingScope: Proposals only. Actual-act inventory and occurrence errors are separate from hints. Omitting a hint never creates a negative label. Scores on this targeted batch do not estimate overall accuracy or held-out AUC.
selection.engineConfidence: Current learned model probability for an individual audit reading. Per-act maximum considers matching act/participants within the event evidence, including hints; every contributing reading and its kind is shown. No matching reading means null, never a fabricated zero.
selection.reviewerConfidence: Subjective confidence in the proposed act, participants and occurrence, not a calibrated model probability.
selection.features: Feature vectors and attribution metadata retained per hit for later training analysis; no story paragraphs or sentence text stored.
selection.inventoryScope: Additional acts are positive proposals within the shown window; not exhaustive negatives until the owner checks coverage. Non-performed descriptions retain memory/imagined/recording/habitual status.
